name: testland/cucumber-testing
description: Use when writing or fixing BDD tests in Gherkin: `.feature` files, Given/When/Then steps, undefined or ambiguous step definitions, or wiring Cucumber into a Java, Kotlin, JavaScript or Ruby build. Covers Cucumber-JVM (JUnit 5), Cucumber-JS and Cucumber-Ruby: feature files, step definitions in the host language, the runner, and JUnit XML reports.
